lock.hypothesis: Resubmit the fixed iter-10 model_combination (GBM x pooled-linear-momentum, 50/50 log-space quantile average) whose submission crashed on a tuple-arity bug before any evaluation. The AWS regime is a quantile average of two forecasters from different classes: (1) gradient_boosting — HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss='quantile') per quantile on trailing 1/3/7-day log changes + 7/14/28-day local vol, pooled over AWS series, 540-day train; (2) pooled_linear_momentum — the champion's class embedded (pooled OLS momentum + vol-window ensemble {7,14,28} at h3/h7 + 0.95 h1 tail narrowing + vol-scaled conformal z). Regimes B/C byte-identical to the champion.

hypothesis_card.mechanism: The champion's pooled LINEAR momentum OLS cannot represent nonlinear state-conditional dynamics (vol clustering, momentum saturation, sticky zones); the GBM member captures them (alone +0.039 Discovery pooled, the largest single-model gain measured in this lab) but its tree q50 drifts on calm sticky zones in-sample. The 50/50 blend lets the tree carry the pooled gain while the linear member anchors the calm-zone center and the calibrated band. Two bugs were fixed in the archived code: the 4-tuple `per[sid] = (lv, X, y, mask)` unpacked as 5 names (the exact crash) and the undefined `mfall` (should be `m2`). The blend weight was chosen by an OOS dense pseudo-origin backtest (24 origins), not the in-sample dry run: w=0.5 dominates w=0.3 on BOTH axes (pooled +0.0379 vs +0.0254; median 0.2767 vs 0.2704) and w=0.7 gains pooled (+0.0459) but loses the median (0.2666, -0.0146 vs champion — Gate-2 risk). The in-sample median deficit at w=0.5 (-0.037) is leakage, not real drift: OOS it shrinks to -0.0045.
hypothesis_card.expected_observation: On Discovery (11 origins): pooled ~0.481 vs champion 0.446 (+0.035, 10/11 origins), h1 +0.047 / h3 +0.034 / h7 +0.034, coverage ~0.801; in-sample median 0.246 (-0.037) is expected to be leakage. On the dense pseudo-origin backtest (24 origins, stride 3): pooled delta +0.038 (z=6.7, 22/24 origins improved), median 0.277 vs champion 0.281 (-0.0045, inside the Gate-2 tolerance), coverage 0.810. On Holdout: pooled ~0.34-0.36 (Gate-1 threshold 0.3118), median ~0.27-0.28 (Gate-2 floor 0.2695), coverage ~0.75-0.80 (in band), all horizons positive.
hypothesis_card.competing_explanation: The rival explanation of the same errors: the +0.038 OOS pooled gain is not the tree's nonlinearity but the GBM's implicit per-series heterogeneity handling (its features include the series' own local vol, so it acts partly as a per-series conditional width model), and the residual median deficit is real tree drift on sticky zones that the backtest's dense pseudo-origins under-weight because they cluster in Aug-Sep where repricing was active. Under this explanation the Holdout median would fall below the Gate-2 floor even though pooled passes, and a linear member with richer per-series features (or a per-series conformal layer on the GBM) would match the blend without any tree.
hypothesis_card.test: Dry run on Discovery (11 origins) vs the champion, plus a dense pseudo-origin backtest (24 origins, stride 3) of w_gbm in {0.3, 0.5, 0.7} to select the weight on OOS evidence rather than the in-sample median. The deciding comparison: the committed w=0.5 blend must beat the champion's Discovery pooled 0.4462 (dry run: 0.4814, screen PASS, would_reach_holdout=true) and its OOS median must stay within the Gate-2 tolerance of the champion's (backtest: -0.0045).
hypothesis_card.rejection_condition: Falsified if holdout pooled <= 0.3118 (Gate 1), or holdout median < 0.2695 (Gate 2), or coverage leaves [0.74, 0.86] (Gate 3), or any horizon skill < -0.020 (Gate 4). The class-exploration mechanism is additionally falsified if the blend's holdout pooled gain over the champion is below +0.005 (both members' Discovery gains were +0.039 and 0.0; a transfer below +0.005 means the tree gain did not transfer out of sample). The weight-selection method is falsified if the holdout median falls below 0.2695 while pooled passes — that would mean the OOS backtest median axis also leaks.

lock.hypothesis: BOLD, model_combination (builds on the crashed iter-10 candidate, family ensemble/model-class exploration): the AWS regime is a 35/65 log-space quantile average of (1) a pooled gradient-boosting member (HistGradientBoostingRegressor loss='quantile' per quantile, features = trailing 1/3/7-day log changes + 7/14/28-day local vol, 540-day pooled train) and (2) the champion's pooled-linear-momentum member (pooled OLS momentum + vol-window ensemble {7,14,28} at h3/h7 + 0.95 h1 tail narrowing + vol-scaled conformal z). The iter-10 crash (tuple-unpack: 4-tuple unpacked as 5, plus an undefined name) was fixed and the code executed for the first time via the mandatory pre-flight fixture before any dry run. Weight w_gbm=0.35 chosen over 0.50 after paired OOS comparison: both transfer strongly on pooled, but w=0.35 holds OOS median at exact champion parity (0.26634 vs 0.26634) and improves the lower-tail series-skill quantiles (q10 -0.072 vs -0.089, q25 +0.028 vs +0.020), minimising Gate-2 failure probability. Regimes B/C byte-identical to the champion.

hypothesis_card.mechanism: The champion's pooled LINEAR momentum OLS cannot represent nonlinear state-conditional dynamics (vol clustering, momentum saturation, sticky zones); the GBM member captures them (alone +0.039 Discovery pooled, 10/11 origins) but its tree q50 drifts on calm sticky zones (-0.039 median, Gate-2 risk). The 35/65 blend lets the tree carry the nonlinear/pooled gain while the linear member anchors the calm-zone center and the calibrated band; quantile averaging is the one width lever with a confirmed-positive record (iters 8/9).
hypothesis_card.expected_observation: Discovery pooled between the members (~0.47, > champion 0.4462), in-sample median below champion (known artifact), coverage in [0.74, 0.86]; OOS pseudo-origin pooled delta strongly positive (z >> 2) with OOS median at or above champion parity and all three horizon deltas positive.
hypothesis_card.competing_explanation: The GBM's Discovery gain is in-sample leakage of the pooled tree fit (fit and scored on overlapping windows) and would not transfer out of sample; the tree q50 drifts on sticky zones, so the blend's holdout median falls below the Gate-2 floor (0.2695) with no pooled transfer.
hypothesis_card.test: Pre-flight fixture (passed: 10 series, 30 rows, ordered/positive/finite quantiles, clip respected, 3.5 s) -> dry_run_discovery (w0.50: pooled 0.4814, +0.0352, screen PASS; w0.35: 0.4731, +0.0269, screen PASS) -> backtest_candidate on 71 dense pseudo-origins (w0.50: +0.0422, z=11.1, 94% origins, OOS median -0.0014; w0.35: +0.0325, z=11.5, 97% origins, OOS median 0.0000). Commit the w0.35 variant as the gate-risk-minimising choice.
hypothesis_card.rejection_condition: Discovery pooled <= champion 0.4462 (screen), or sanity failures, or OOS backtest pooled delta <= 0; at Holdout: pooled <= 0.3118 (Gate 1), or median < 0.2695 (Gate 2), or coverage outside [0.74, 0.86] (Gate 3), or any horizon skill < -0.020 (Gate 4). The class-exploration mechanism is additionally falsified if the blend's holdout pooled gain vs champion is below +0.005 (the tree's OOS gain did not transfer).
